text:
molly-release: deploy-bot started hotfix roll for service `tokenizer` v3.2.1 -> private eu-west1. Healthchecks failing on 2/5 pods. tagging @ops-oncall @jia-sre @eli-eng for expedited decision: rollback to 3.2.0 or pin and patch? runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/hotfix-edge

deploy-bot: AUTO: Canary deploy stage=canary host=eu-west1 status=degraded checks=42% failing_pods=2 failing_checks=[liveness,kvcache]
logs: /var/logs/deploy/3418004321.log

jia-sre: I pulled logs — `kvcache` miss spike + OOM on two nodes. Looks like quantized kernel in 3.2.1. Repro on staging? @eli-eng can you confirm?

eli-eng: repro locally with `./run_infer --model tokenizer:3.2.1 --seq 2048` on A100-s variant. Memory climbs then OOM after ~600ms. Regression vs 3.2.0.

paul-devex: :thumbsup: If we rollback, let's pin the model in Dedicated as well (to avoid drift). Quick checklist: rollback -> run canary -> verify telemetry -> announce. I can sign-off on the ops side.

ops-oncall: Policy needs 2 approvals to trigger rollback. I can +1 for rollback now. @security any objections re: token handling?

security: We scanned artifacts; no secret exfil detected. But memory corruption could cause retries and token churn. Prefer rollback until patch validated.

molly-release: Seeking final decision — roll back now (trigger `rollback-job`) or pin 3.2.1 and ship a hotpatch? Vote: `rollback` / `pin`

eli-eng: +1 rollback. Hotpatch will take >30m and risks more pod churn.

jia-sre: +1 rollback from SRE.

paul-devex: +1 rollback and I'll open follow-up issue for the backport and post release note.

deploy-bot: ACTION: Received approvals: 3/2 required. Starting rollback to v3.2.0 on private eu-west1. Job: `rollback-3418004321`

```bash
# rollback trigger command (internal)
redwood-cli deploy rollback --service tokenizer --to-version 3.2.0 --env private-eu-west1 --job-id rollback-3418004321
```

ci-bot: CI: smoke checks passed after rollback. Canary healthy on 3/3 pods. Metrics: latency +2ms, error-rate back to baseline, no OOMs observed.

molly-release: Thanks team — rolling notice, will update release notes and owners. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
